grow.title: How a website helps your business grow
grow.subtitle: Simple answers. No computer words.

points.title: Customers look on Google first
points.text: Before visiting a shop or clinic, many people search on their phone. If you have a website, they find you. If not, they find someone else.

points.title: Your shop is open 24 hours online
points.text: Even at night, people can see your products, prices and timings.

points.title: More calls and WhatsApp enquiries
points.text: Big call and WhatsApp buttons. One tap and the customer is talking to you.

points.title: People trust a business with a website
points.text: A clean website with real photos shows you are a serious business.

points.title: Answer common questions once
points.text: Put your timings, prices, location and menu on the website. Fewer repeated calls.

points.title: Sell beyond your area
points.text: With an online store, customers from other cities can buy from you too.

points.title: Your own name online
points.text: Your website has its own address, like yourshop.in. Easy to share on visiting cards and WhatsApp.

grow.closingText: Send us a WhatsApp. We will tell you honestly what will help your business.

faq.q: How long does it take to make a website?
faq.a: A simple website takes about 1 to 2 weeks. Bigger websites take longer. We tell you the date before we start.

faq.q: I don't know much about computers. Can I still get a website?
faq.a: Yes. We do everything. You just tell us about your business on call or WhatsApp.

faq.q: Will my website work on mobile?
faq.a: Yes. Every website works perfectly on mobile, tablet and computer.

faq.q: Can I change photos and prices myself?
faq.a: Yes, with the Business package and above. We teach you how. Or just WhatsApp us and we will do it.

faq.q: Can my website be in Hindi?
faq.a: Yes. We can make your website in Hindi, English, or both.
For {carePrice} a month, we take care of your website. We keep it online, safe and backed up, and make small changes for you.

about.title: About Sitewala
about.subtitle: Websites for local businesses, explained in simple words.
story: Hi, I am Manvir Singh, the founder of Sitewala.
I saw many good local businesses with no website, or with an old website that did not bring any customers.
I also saw that many website companies talk in difficult computer words. Business owners did not understand what they were paying for.
So I started Sitewala. We make websites that bring customers, we explain everything in simple words, and we show our prices openly.

why.text: No computer words. We explain everything in plain Hindi or English.
